description: The Automations tab: the rule that copies each new Instagram post to YouTube and TikTok. The server runs these inside a Chirpy turn through the same operation as the tab's save button. Retrying a failed copy posts it, so it has no action.

actions.description: Change the cross-posting rule: turn it on or off, where new Instagram posts are copied, and its caption options. Only the fields sent change. The creator is asked to confirm first.

stripHashtags.description: Remove hashtags from the copied caption.

reformatForYouTube.description: Use the caption's first line as the YouTube title.
